items.what: Rebuild ulkro (python3 art/build.py fighter ulkro). The source already has the diagonal wraps, the moving recall, and 'wraps' in ASYM so the shin wraps decimate to 800 tris. After the build, run decimate_chains --every 2 --prefix x_ --orm-q 40 --normal-q 70, then the slow clips with --prefix '' --clip idle,idle_lobby,recall,taunt,stunned,victory,channel, and check three_load_test --budget-kb 1172. One Burdam rebuild with Almanac cloth one more step (about #3E3649) and COWL_K about 0.20 should clear dE > 10.8 and cowl swing >= 10 deg. An Ardit rebuild is needed for the recall and the helm form.
Ardit needs a rebuild for a moving recall and the helm pass; none of it has been started. It is the remaining par item with no work done.

Shipped GLBs differ from a clean build. Rebuilding Burdam needs scale_track_swing (if COWL_K 0.28 falls short), decimate_chains, and glb_paint_grade: pauldrons with --box -0.80,-0.40,1.48,-0.44,0.40,1.98 --box -0.80,-0.40,1.72,-0.22,0.40,1.98 --box 0.46,-0.45,1.28,0.90,0.45,2.15 --box 0.22,-0.45,1.74,0.90,0.45,2.15 --recess 1.4 --ref-q 80 --q 60, Almanac with --dark-gain 0.72 --dark-l 0.40 --q 62. Rebuilding Ulkro needs decimate_chains, glb_simplify --ratio 0.78 --error 0.004, base colour q56, ORM q30, normal q55; Long Evening base colour q62. A rebuild is also what would give Burdam a part map.
